anchors.quote: we created a oversized set of sprints expressly to normalize config and logging around sc-observability logger (injected).  why do you keep adding more loggers to the design? ... add a new anchor banning python_logger ... lock this
anchors.summary: No second Logger around an injected logger (ban python_logger)
anchors.scope: touches crates/sc-agent-log, crates/sc-agent-py, crates/sc-treesitter-py or the sc-decidr generated client, or any code path that accepts an injected logger (general_log=, session_log=)
anchors.deterministic_check: git grep -n 'fn python_logger' crates returns nothing, and no LoggerBuilder call in crates/sc-agent-py, crates/sc-treesitter-py or crates/sc-agent-log is reached from a path that received an injected Python Logger
